summary: Computer Science student building full-stack web applications with Node.js, Express and MySQL. Implemented a Genetic Algorithm timetable generator from scratch in JavaScript and shipped a responsive campus events platform.

projects.name: ChronoGen - Automatic Timetable Generator
bullets: Engineered an automatic timetable generation system using a Genetic Algorithm implemented from scratch in JavaScript.
Modeled academic constraints (rooms, faculty, slots) to produce conflict-free schedules.

projects.name: CampusConnect - Campus Event Management Platform
bullets: Designed and developed a responsive frontend for a campus event and club discovery platform using HTML, Tailwind CSS and JavaScript.

education.degree: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering
